title: E&N April/May Update: all four DIPs GIPs approved, graph-node v0.43.0
summary: The Graph Council approved GIP-0076, 0086, 0087, and 0088 — clearing the final governance hurdle for on-chain Decentralized Indexing Payments (DIPs). graph-node v0.43.0 ships per-chain RPC config and Subgraph log querying. Gateway v27.6.0 adds x402 payment support.
body:
The Graph Council approved all four GIPs underpinning Decentralized Indexing Payments (DIPs) in April 2026, clearing the final governance hurdle before mainnet launch. The approved GIPs are:

• GIP-0076: Issuance Allocator Contract
• GIP-0086: Rewards Manager & Subgraph Service Upgrade
• GIP-0087: On-Chain Indexing Agreements
• GIP-0088: Issuance Allocator Deployment

Audit fixes have been submitted and testnet stress testing is ongoing against the real scoring pipeline. Mainnet deployment is now pending final audit sign-off.

Software releases in this period:
• graph-node v0.43.0: per-chain RPC configuration, automatic provider failover, Subgraph log querying via GraphQL, call cache optimization
• Gateway v27.6.0: x402 payment support for queries, restored query attestations

REO (Rewards Eligibility Oracle) testnet contracts are deployed; mainnet launch described as imminent with final testing wrapping up.

title: GRC-006: Mainline — Firehose data service on Horizon proposed
summary: Community RFC to bring raw Firehose block streams on-chain as a Horizon data service. Staked indexers serve fork-aware block data over gRPC, paid via GraphTally. Phase 0 testnet targets Q2 2026; Phase 1 limited mainnet with 3–5 operators Q3 2026.
body:
Petko Pavlovski (cargopete) filed GRC-006 on April 24, 2026, proposing Mainline — a decentralized Firehose block stream data service built on Horizon.

Mainline delivers raw, fork-aware blockchain data over gRPC. It is the data layer beneath Substreams, Subgraphs, and other Graph services. Indexers stake GRT to operate it; consumers pay via GraphTally using existing Horizon payment primitives.

Timeline:
• Phase 0 (Q1–Q2 2026): Testnet with one operator
• Phase 1 (Q2–Q3 2026): Limited mainnet — 3–5 operators, 4 chains (Ethereum, Base, Solana, Arbitrum One)
• Phase 2 (Q4 2026): General availability, permissionless registration
• Phase 3 (Q1–Q2 2027): Cryptographic verification

This is a community RFC — not yet a formal GIP. No Council vote has been held.

title: Marc-André Dumas joins The Graph Council
summary: The Graph Foundation welcomes Marc-André Dumas to the Council, bringing deep technical experience from oracle systems at MakerDAO and Chronicle Labs, and founding his own infrastructure company.
body:
The Graph Foundation welcomes Marc-André Dumas to the Council, bringing a deeply technical perspective shaped by years of building critical infrastructure across both web2 and web3.

From working on oracle systems at MakerDAO and Chronicle Labs to founding his own infrastructure company, his experience sits right at the intersection of reliability, scalability, and decentralization.

As the network grows, governance decisions require both strategic vision and real technical understanding. This is exactly the kind of perspective being added.

title: Gateway upgrade will penalize old graph-node / indexer-service versions
summary: Testnet this week, mainnet next week. Minimum versions: graph-node v0.36.0, indexer-service v1.7.0. Only affects query selection scoring — indexing rewards unaffected.
body:
In the next couple of days we will be rolling out a gateway upgrade that will (indirectly) penalize scoring in the selection algorithm for indexers serving queries with old versions of graph-node / indexer-service. This will only affect indexer's chance of getting selected to serve queries, indexing rewards are not affected at all. The upgrade will hit testnet later this week, and mainnet next week.

The minimum versions to avoid this are:
• graph-node v0.36.0
• indexer-service v1.7.0

Indexers that need to take action (only includes indexers with a reachable URL):
• 0x2e15f3...b47a — swift-staking.com → Update indexer-service to v1.7.0 or greater
• 0xdecba5...cbb5 — decisionbasis.cc → Update indexer-service to v1.7.0 or greater
• 0x1b92e4...788c — thegraph.vincenttaglia.com → Update graph-node to v0.36.0 or greater
• 0x59749d...f54 — gunu-node.com → Unknown graph-node version, please check

title: Indexing rewards deprecated for Substreams-powered Subgraphs effective April 16th
summary: Indexers must close allocations or submit POIs between April 13–15 to collect accrued rewards. Follows GIP 0084 — rewards now focus on chains with sustained query volume and active developer usage.
body:
Indexing rewards will be deprecated for Substreams-powered Subgraphs effective April 16th, 2026.

Important Action Steps:
Indexers will need to close allocations or submit POIs between April 13th and April 15th to ensure that you collect accrued rewards.

Additional Context:
Following GIP 0084, The Graph Network is refining how protocol resources, particularly indexing rewards, are allocated. Rewards will now focus on chains and features that demonstrate:
• Sustained query volume
• Strong ecosystem adoption
• Active developer usage
